title: Building OpenAI with OpenAI
summary: At OpenAI, we rely on our own technology to help streamline work, scale expertise, and drive outcomes. In our new series, OpenAI on OpenAI, we share lessons to help other organizations do the same.
body: At OpenAI, we rely on our own technology to help streamline work, scale expertise, and drive outcomes. In our new series, OpenAI on OpenAI, we share lessons to help other organizations do the same.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出“OpenAI on OpenAI”全新系列文章，探讨其如何通过自身技术精简日常工作、规模化沉淀专业知识，并推动业务成果，为外部组织的大模型落地提供经验借鉴。原始信息显示：At OpenAI, we rely on our own technology to help streamline work, scale expertise, and drive outcomes. In our new series, OpenAI on OpenAI, we share lessons to help other organizations do the same.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Building OpenAI with OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI通过新系列文章总结自身采用大模型优化工作流程的经验，为其他组织提供了实践参考。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
